result.title: ReFineR: Single image to dense point cloud registration at pixel level with point splatting
result.summary: Cameras and LiDARs (Light Detection and Ranging) provide complementary observations of the same scene: cameras capture rich appearance cues while LiDAR sensors provide accurate geometric measurements. In this work, we address the problem of fine image-to-point cloud registration from a single image and a roughly estimated camera pose. On robotic platforms, residual reprojection errors of several pixels are commonly observed even after calibration due to temporal desynchronization, mechanical vibrations, or inaccuracies in point cloud reconstruction. Such errors can lead to decimeter-level geometric discrepancies at moderate distances and significantly affect multiple downstream tasks, such as dense cross-modal supervision, texture mapping, and semantic label transfer. To address this challenge, we introduce ReFineR: an offline framework to finely register individual images to pre-reconstructed point clouds. ReFineR builds upon differentiable point splatting rasterization and a smooth Gradient Orientation Measure (GOM) to iteratively refine the camera pose through analysis-by-synthesis optimization. We evaluated the method on a curated dataset of manually calibrated images collected from heterogeneous data sources. Furthermore, we show that an automatic point cloud rescale factor can be estimated prior to optimization, enabling robust refinement across a wide range of scenarios using a single scale-invariant formulation. The project page can be found at https://refiner-project.github.io/

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ReFineR：从单张图像与粗略估计的相机位姿出发，借助可微点泼溅光栅化与平滑梯度方向度量（GOM），以分析—合成方式迭代优化位姿，实现像素级图像—点云精细配准，并在自建异源手工标定数据上评测，同时给出可先验估计的点云尺度因子。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作本身是离线跨模态位姿精校准，不涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 状态；但其「渲染当前假设—与观测比对—迭代修正」的可微泼溅回路，可能为 LVR 中如何用高精度几何证据校验与筛选视觉证据提供思路线索，可供核查。
